facts.fact: Reporting through DHIS2 across Uganda improved from 58 percent in 2020 to 98 percent in 2025, and Makerere handed the digital health systems including DHIS2 to the Ministry of Health on 31 March 2026, per Makerere University News.
DHIS2 reporting rose from 58 percent in 2020 to 98 percent in 2025, per Makerere University News on the MakSPH-METS programme.
